verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. The greedy construction terminates and must return to its start by parity of used and unused edge-ends. A longest closed trail cannot omit an edge: connectedness supplies a vertex on the trail incident with an omitted edge, the unused-edge spanning subgraph has even degree at every vertex, and a nonempty closed trail in that subgraph can be spliced into the original trail, contradicting maximality. All hypotheses are used, and there are no external references or hard-prohibition violations.
